translations.web: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?
translations.bsb: Is this your jubilant city, whose origin is from antiquity, whose feet have taken her to settle far away?
translations.kjv: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
translations.asv: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her afar off to sojourn?
